title: The Red Hot Chili Peppers
notes: Jagged funk-punk debut; syncopated bass and brass collide with restrained studio sound.

title: Freaky Styley
notes: Clinton loosens the grooves, bringing Detroit funk players and prominent horns into the mix.

title: The Uplift Mofo Party Plan
notes: Original quartet reunites for aggressive funk-rock, rapid-fire vocals and occasional psychedelic passages.

title: Mother's Milk
notes: Frusciante and Smith sharpen the band’s crossover sound with layered guitars and brass.
